// Reference translation of pie_list `node_new`: allocates a zeroed node and fills its record.
// It returns a pointer, so the function-level test only compiles it.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Node {
    pub rec: Record,
    pub next: *mut Node,
}

/// `calloc(1, sizeof *n)`, `exit(3)` when it fails, then the fields; the name is copied with
/// `strncpy` into at most 15 bytes (the last byte of the field stays NUL from `calloc`).
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn node_new(
    id: i32,
    name: *const u8,
    x: i32,
    y: i32,
    w: f64,
) -> *const u8 {
    unsafe {
        let n = rt::calloc(1, std::mem::size_of::<Node>()) as *mut Node;
        if n.is_null() {
            rt::exit(3);
        }
        (*n).rec.id = id;
        rt::strncpy((*n).rec.name.as_mut_ptr(), name, 15);
        (*n).rec.pos.x = x;
        (*n).rec.pos.y = y;
        (*n).rec.weight = w;
        n as *const u8
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `list_push`: puts a node at the head of the list.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Node {
    pub rec: Record,
    pub next: *mut Node,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct List {
    pub head: *mut Node,
    pub count: i32,
}

/// `n->next = l->head; l->head = n; l->count++;`
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn list_push(l: *mut List, n: *mut Node) {
    unsafe {
        (*n).next = (*l).head;
        (*l).head = n;
        (*l).count = (*l).count.wrapping_add(1);
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `cmp_id`: the difference of the ids (called through a
// function pointer only).

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,

/// `return a->id - b->id;` The subtraction wraps, as the generated code does.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn cmp_id(a: *const Record, b: *const Record) -> i32 {
    unsafe { (*a).id.wrapping_sub((*b).id) }
}

// Reference translation of pie_list `cmp_dist` (corpus/src/pie_list.c).

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

fn dist2(p: &Point) -> i32 {
    p.x.wrapping_mul(p.x).wrapping_add(p.y.wrapping_mul(p.y))
}

/// Squared distance from the origin of each record's position; returns their difference.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn cmp_dist(a: *const Record, b: *const Record) -> i32 {
    unsafe { dist2(&(*a).pos).wrapping_sub(dist2(&(*b).pos)) }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `list_sort`: bubble sort of the linked list by relinking
// nodes, with a comparison callback that receives the two records.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Node {
    pub rec: Record,
    pub next: *mut Node,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct List {
    pub head: *mut Node,
    pub count: i32,
}

pub type CmpFn = unsafe extern "C" fn(*const Record, *const Record) -> i32;

/// Passes over the list until nothing is swapped; two neighbours swap when `cmp(a, b) > 0`.
/// `pp` points at the link that points at `a`, which is how the swap relinks without a
/// previous-node pointer.
#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn list_sort(l: *mut List, cmp: Option<CmpFn>) {
    unsafe {
        loop {
            let mut swapped = false;
            let mut pp: *mut *mut Node = &mut (*l).head;
            while !(*pp).is_null() && !(**pp).next.is_null() {
                let a = *pp;
                let b = (*a).next;
                if cmp.expect("comparison callback")(&(*a).rec, &(*b).rec) > 0 {
                    (*a).next = (*b).next;
                    (*b).next = a;
                    *pp = b;
                    swapped = true;
                }
                pp = &mut (**pp).next;
            }
            if !swapped {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `list_each`: calls a visitor on each record, head first.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Node {
    pub rec: Record,
    pub next: *mut Node,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct List {
    pub head: *mut Node,
    pub count: i32,
}

pub type VisitFn = unsafe extern "C" fn(*const Record, *mut u8);

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn list_each(l: *const List, f: Option<VisitFn>, ctx: *mut u8) {
    unsafe {
        let mut n = (*l).head;
        while !n.is_null() {
            f.expect("visit callback")(&(*n).rec, ctx);
            n = (*n).next;
        }
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `print_rec`: one line per record (called through a function
// pointer only). The decompile lists the arguments of the variadic call in register order; the C
// source passes id, name, x, y and weight.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn print_rec(r: *const Record, _ctx: *mut u8) {
    unsafe {
        rt::printf(
            b"  #%d %-6s (%d,%d) %.1f\n\0".as_ptr(),
            &[
                rt::Arg::Int(i64::from((*r).id)),
                rt::Arg::Ptr((*r).name.as_ptr()),
                rt::Arg::Int(i64::from((*r).pos.x)),
                rt::Arg::Int(i64::from((*r).pos.y)),
                rt::Arg::Double((*r).weight),
            ],
        );
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `sum_weight`: adds a record's weight to the double `ctx`
// points to (called through a function pointer only).

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn sum_weight(r: *const Record, ctx: *mut u8) {
    unsafe {
        *(ctx as *mut f64) += (*r).weight;
    }
}

// Reference translation of pie_list `list_free`: frees every node and empties the list.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Point {
    pub x: i32,
    pub y: i32,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Record {
    pub id: i32,
    pub name: [u8; 16],
    pub pos: Point,
    pub weight: f64,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct Node {
    pub rec: Record,
    pub next: *mut Node,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct List {
    pub head: *mut Node,
    pub count: i32,
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn list_free(l: *mut List) {
    unsafe {
        while !(*l).head.is_null() {
            let n = (*l).head;
            (*l).head = (*n).next;
            rt::free(n as *mut u8);
        }
        (*l).count = 0;
    }
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>

// Reference translation of pie_list `main`; the entry point of the program. Builds a list of four
// records, sorts it three ways through comparison callbacks, prints it with a visitor and sums the
// weights with another. The callbacks are other translated functions passed by address.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct List {
    pub head: *mut u8,
    pub count: i32,
}

#[unsafe(no_mangle)]
pub unsafe extern "C" fn fn_1014da() -> i32 {
    let mut l = List {
        head: std::ptr::null_mut(),
        count: 0,
    };
    let lp = &mut l as *mut List;
    unsafe {
        list_push(lp as _, node_new(3, b"gamma\0".as_ptr() as _, 5, 1, 2.5) as _);
        list_push(lp as _, node_new(1, b"delta\0".as_ptr() as _, -2, 7, 1.25) as _);
        list_push(lp as _, node_new(2, b"alpha\0".as_ptr() as _, 0, 3, 9.0) as _);
        list_push(lp as _, node_new(4, b"beta\0".as_ptr() as _, 1, 1, 0.5) as _);

        // The table of orders: a label and the comparison function, as addresses.
        let orders: [(&[u8], usize); 3] = [
            (b"by id\0", cmp_id as usize),
            (b"by name\0", cmp_name as usize),
            (b"by distance\0", cmp_dist as usize),
        ];
        for (label, cmp) in orders.iter() {
            rt::printf(b"%s:\n\0".as_ptr(), &[rt::Arg::Ptr(label.as_ptr())]);
            list_sort(lp as _, std::mem::transmute::<usize, _>(*cmp));
            list_each(
                lp as _,
                std::mem::transmute::<usize, _>(print_rec as usize),
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
            );
        }
        let mut total: f64 = 0.0;
        list_each(
            lp as _,
            std::mem::transmute::<usize, _>(sum_weight as usize),
            &mut total as *mut f64 as _,
        );
        rt::printf(
            b"count=%d total=%.2f\n\0".as_ptr(),
            &[rt::Arg::Int(i64::from(l.count)), rt::Arg::Double(total)],
        );
        list_free(lp as _);
    }
    0
}
</kraken-rust>
<kraken-result>{"assumptions": [], "unsupported": []}</kraken-result>
